message_update: Pi carries top-level usage; rpi carries message/eventType and no top-level usage.
Pi emits six entry_appended records for pi-cursor-sdk capability notices in the Cursor segments; rpi emits none.
Extension status/notification records differ in count and position (cursor setStatus, antigravity notify).

Antigravity request body differs (system prompt text and site; rpi system prompt lacks Pi's <cwd> section and tool prose). The projection (method/path/account/project) matches; bodies are recorded but not compared.
blocked: rpi multiprovider pool registration and virtual provider: rpi-multiprovider at base adc459b has no rpi_plugin_register export; loading librpi_multiprovider.so registers nothing (M-NATIVE, M-VIRTUAL-B and the H-DELEG host port are unmerged). The harness already writes multiprovider-auth.json (pools + virtuals) into both sides' agent directories, so the candidate catalog gains parity-virtual as soon as the native wrapper lands.

Pi 1.3.0 + pi-cursor-sdk 0.5.3 cannot be pooled or placed behind a virtual provider: multiprovider/src/lift.ts applyResolvedAuth (and src/virtual.ts) call the backing streamSimple with a new headers object, so cursor-provider-binding.ts cannot find its request-ownership receipt. Both paths fail before the SDK is reached (pinned negative segments).
